name: Chaos
role: Ruler of the primordial void between Hell and the created universe
description: Category C, essentially non-biblical. Draws overwhelmingly on Hesiod's Theogony, where Chaos is the first thing to exist. Genesis 1:2 ('the earth was without form, and void') gives Milton only the barest hint of a pre-creation formless state; the elaborate personified mythology of Chaos as a ruling deity with a court (also naming Orcus, Ades/Hades, Demogorgon in passing) is classical borrowing, not biblical content. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §III.
narrative_function: Grants Satan passage through the Abyss toward the newly created World -- the geography Satan must cross to reach Eden.
